payload.body: Task 1 start. Approach: de-spawn the nine exam files one at a time, in this order — design-system-installed (pure deletion), pin-todo, delete-to-trash, exam-page, undo-delete, persistence-exam, interaction-evidence, styled-page, derived-exam (the rewrites). For each: delete the spawning legs the Context names, rewrite the spawned greps over app files as readFileSync + the same predicate, and rewrite the spawned exam/CLI runs as in-process calls (runStateExam, runPersistenceExam, the tinyapp-history src functions). Then run the file alone and check the floor, and finally the M1 grep sweep over all nine.

payload.author: impl:2@run-27
payload.body: Approach: de-spawn the twelve exam files. For each, delete the legs whose only content is a child process over another prover (the linter's tests, sibling exams, tsc), and rewrite the spawned grep/sed predicates over *app* files (client/src/*, package.json) as in-process readFileSync reads with the same predicate. Every in-process leg at BASE is kept verbatim. Then reword the comments/doc headers that mention bun/bunx/tsc/tinyapp-lint/spawn so the M1 pattern prints nothing. Floors per file are in the task Context; I verify each file alone.

payload.body: Seven of nine done and green alone: design-system-installed 11 pass [1.52s], exam-page 7 [1.36s], pin-todo 36 [2.42s], undo-delete 9 [2.76s], persistence-exam 4 [3.38s], delete-to-trash 36 [2.43s], interaction-evidence 8 [6.83s]. Same sentence ('the new step immediately before the exam package's, which stays last'), no blocked literal. The floor of 9 assumed both halves gone, so this sits one above it.
